2609.18515.title: Beyond Routine Compliance: Cunning Data Cultivates Safety Vigilance in Large Language Models
2609.18515.paper_summary: Safety alignment teaches large language models (LLMs) to recognize harmful requests and reject risky instructions. Yet aligned models can fail when harmful intent is concealed within seemingly benign contexts. Robust safety therefore requires both knowledge of safety boundaries and \textbf{vigilance}: the ability to detect unusual premises, misleading reasoning, and latent risks beneath surface-level semantics. Vigilance requires models to scrutinize a request's underlying intent and assumptions before acting. To cultivate this capability, we introduce \textbf{cunning questions}, which are not necessarily safety-related but contain misleading premises, atypical reasoning, or subtle inconsistencies. We hypothesize that learning to look beyond such reasoning traps can transfer to safety-critical scenarios. Experiments show that Cunning training improves robustness to out-of-distribution jailbreak attacks and strengthens subsequent safety fine-tuning. Furthermore, augmenting an existing state-of-the-art safety alignment pipeline with Cunning establishes a new state of the art across our evaluated settings, reducing mean ASR across nine backbone--benchmark combinations from 17.40\% to 15.05\%. Trace analysis after matched safety fine-tuning suggests that safety judgments are more likely to govern responses before harmful planning begins. A conditional theoretical analysis further characterizes when invariance learned from cunning data can transfer to safety-related inputs. These findings suggest that cunning data can strengthen model vigilance and complement conventional safety alignment.
2609.18515.paper_summary_zh: 安全對齊教導大型語言模型（LLMs）識別有害請求並拒絕風險指令。<lb/>然而，當有害意圖隱藏在看似無害的背景中時，對齊模型可能會失敗。<lb/>因此，穩健的安全性需要對安全邊界的知識和\textbf{警覺性}：檢測異常前提、誤導性推理和潛在風險的能力，這些風險隱藏在表面語義之下。<lb/>警覺性要求模型在行動之前仔細檢查請求的潛在意圖和假設。<lb/>為了培養這種能力，我們引入了\textbf{狡猾問題}，這些問題不一定與安全相關，但包含誤導性前提、非典型推理或微妙的不一致性。<lb/>我們假設學會超越這些推理陷阱的能力可以轉移到安全關鍵的場景中。<lb/>實驗顯示，狡猾訓練提高了對分佈外越獄攻擊的穩健性，並加強了隨後的安全微調。<lb/>此外，通過狡猾增強現有的最先進安全對齊流程，在我們評估的設置中建立了新的最先進水平，將九個主幹-基準組合的平均ASR從17.40\%降低到15.05\%。<lb/>在匹配的安全微調後的追蹤分析表明，在有害規劃開始之前，安全判斷更有可能主導反應。<lb/>一個條件理論分析進一步描述了從狡猾數據學到的不變性何時可以轉移到與安全相關的輸入。<lb/>這些發現表明，狡猾數據可以增強模型的警覺性，並補充傳統的安全對齊。
